title: Cluster problems
truncated: There are too many problems: only the most recent ones are listed.
noneNew: No new problems since the mark.

messages.meshUnknownHost: Routes to {{host}}, which no Service or ServiceEntry has: the proxy answers 503.
messages.meshMissingDestinationRule: Routes to subset {{subset}} of {{host}}, but no destination rule covers that host: the proxy answers 503.
messages.meshMissingSubset: Routes to subset {{subset}} of {{host}}, which destination rule {{rule}} does not define: the proxy answers 503.
messages.meshMissingGateway: Bound to gateway {{gateway}}, which does not exist.
messages.meshTlsConflict: Sets TLS mode {{mode}} toward {{host}}, whose workloads accept only Istio mTLS (STRICT): calls fail. Use ISTIO_MUTUAL.
messages.meshConflictingVirtualService: Host {{host}} on {{gateway}} is already taken by the older virtual service {{other}}: the routes of this one are not reached.
messages.meshInvalidVirtualService: Has the host * while bound to the sidecars (mesh): Istio rejects it, so none of its routes are used.
